title: Constructibility of subobject part
statement: The subobject in the constructible short exact sequence argument is constructible.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Proposition 09BH (proposition-constructible-over-noetherian), part (2): on a Noetherian scheme every sub and quotient sheaf of a constructible abelian sheaf is constructible; with Definition 03RW (definition-constructible) and Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated), which identifies Stacks' affine-local definition with the global finite partition of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion] on the quasi-compact quasi-separated $C$; $C$ is Noetherian, being of finite type over a field. Cited in the proof of Lemma 0A5C (lemma-ses-statements).

proof.text: Apply the finite torsion bound and cyclic-module comparison from the parent node, then apply the Noetherian subobject/cokernel theorem and transport constructibility across the induced isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 09BH (proposition-constructible-over-noetherian) (2)/(3) and its proof, with Lemma 03RZ (lemma-constructible-abelian), Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated) and the first paragraph of Section 'Constructible sheaves on Noetherian schemes'; step 1 (one integer N kills F) and the Z/N-module bridge are written out by the agent.

split_report.summary: Strict intermediate conclusion split from the parent six-step proof; remaining proof follows the parent node.
